name: dispatch_command_bytes_and_update
description: Tests the record's mode byte against 0 and 1 and two command byte pairs; on the matching pair it sets a flag byte in a second record, then runs the shared record update. Otherwise it branches to the same update path.

name: set_flag_on_command_match
description: Sets a flag byte in the secondary record when the command byte pair matches, then calls the shared record update. Mode-byte checks gate the second update step.

name: set_secondary_flag_and_update
description: Unconditionally sets a flag byte in the secondary record and calls the shared record update, which resets timers and decrements a countdown byte.

name: set_flag_on_pair_match
description: Checks a two-byte command pair in the record and, when it matches, sets a flag byte in the secondary record before branching into the shared update.

name: set_flag_on_byte_match
description: Sets a flag byte in the secondary record when the record's second command byte matches a fixed value, then runs the shared record update.

name: set_secondary_flag_update
description: Sets a flag byte in the secondary record on a command match and falls into the shared record update routine.

name: update_record_with_threshold_check
description: Calls a helper, compares a signed value derived from a record byte against zero, and conditionally calls further helpers before the shared record update.

name: lookup_direction_table_entry
description: Decrements a BCD counter in the secondary record and stores a direction index in the record. When the table entry at that index matches a fixed character, it copies the entry into the secondary record and clears the table slot.

name: store_index_and_lookup_entry
description: Stores an index from the input register into the record, decrements a BCD counter in the secondary record, and copies a matching table entry into the record's position bytes and the secondary record.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_and_lookup
description: Decrements a BCD counter in the secondary record and, when the table entry at the stored index matches a fixed character, copies it into the secondary record and clears the table slot.

name: copy_table_entry_into_record
description: Copies a table entry selected by an index into the record's two position bytes, clears the table slot, and runs the shared record update.

name: match_state_two_and_update
description: Returns early unless the record's mode byte equals 2 and two further record bytes match fixed values, then runs the shared record update.

name: run_shared_record_update
description: Contains only a call to the shared record update routine; the rest of the body is the update code itself with no separate logic.

name: decrement_bcd_when_flag_clear
description: Calls helpers and, when the zero flag is clear, decrements a BCD counter in the secondary record, then runs the shared record update.

name: decrement_secondary_bcd_counter
description: Decrements a BCD counter in the secondary record when it is non-zero, then runs the shared record update.

name: reset_record_position_and_update
description: Zeroes the record's two position bytes, saves a global value into the record, sets the global to a fixed value and restores it, then runs the shared record update.

name: reset_position_and_restore_global
description: Zeroes the record's position bytes, stores a global into the record, sets the global to a fixed value and restores it from the record before the shared update.

name: branch_on_mode_and_update
description: Branches on the record's mode byte, calling helpers in the matching path before the shared record update.

name: call_helpers_and_update_record
description: Calls several helper routines in sequence and then runs the shared record update; it has no direct field writes of its own.

name: copy_record_key_fields
description: Copies a byte from a fixed record offset into another field, copies the record's first two bytes into two further fields, then calls helpers and returns.

name: call_five_helpers_in_sequence
description: Calls five helper routines in sequence and returns, with no direct field writes of its own.

name: call_four_helpers_in_sequence
description: Calls four helper routines in sequence and returns, with no direct field writes of its own.

name: call_two_helpers_then_return
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns. The body makes no direct writes to the record or globals.

name: fill_global_constant_table
description: Writes nine fixed byte values into consecutive global cells and returns. It only initialises the table.

name: read_bounded_selection_value
description: Calls helpers and reads a value that is accepted only when below five; the referenced text is the prompt 'Ready for #'. An accepted value is stored in the record minus one, and a rejected value clears a flag and calls the shared update.

name: clear_flag_and_update_record
description: Clears a flag byte in the record, calls two helpers, and runs the shared record update.

name: store_selection_and_wait_key
description: Stores the selection minus one in the record and clears a flag, then loops calling a helper until the returned byte falls within a fixed key range.

name: select_weapon_from_key_input
description: Waits for a key in a fixed range and stores its offset plus a constant in the record. When the matching secondary table entry is non-zero it calls a helper, with the referenced text 'WEAPON-' shown in the prompt.

name: invoke_helpers_then_update_record
description: Calls four helper routines and then runs the shared record update, with no direct field writes of its own.

name: invoke_five_helpers_then_update
description: Calls five helper routines and then runs the shared record update, with no direct field writes of its own.

name: find_table_index_for_byte
description: Stores an input byte in the record, scans a table of eleven entries for the secondary record's byte, and compares the matching entry with the stored value.

name: update_record_state_and_timers
description: Branches on the record's mode byte, resets two timer bytes to 24, decrements a countdown byte when it is non-zero, copies the first two bytes into the position bytes and calls helpers. It is the shared update routine used by many neighbouring routines.

name: initialize_record_and_process_input
description: Copies a saved byte pair into the record, clears the mode byte and sets a sentinel byte. It then calls many helpers, sets a global to 1, scans a table, and branches on a key code.

name: reset_record_timer_field
description: Sets one timer byte of the record to 24 and returns; the body is a single store.

name: check_record_match_for_state
description: Returns zero when the mode byte is 128, byte 15 equals 3 and the record's byte at offset 77 matches a global; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: tick_countdown_and_reload
description: Returns early unless the mode byte is zero. It decrements a countdown byte and, at zero, reloads it with 12, calls a helper and decrements a second countdown byte.

name: clamp_value_to_upper_limit
description: Adds one to the input byte and clamps the result to 176 when it exceeds 183, then returns it.

name: reset_timers_and_call_helpers
description: Sets two record bytes to 8 and 0, calls four helper routines and returns.

name: select_reload_value_from_global
description: When the mode byte is zero it compares a global with a fixed value and stores 24 or 12 into a global. It then loops over a global table copying entries into the record's position bytes.

name: copy_table_pairs_into_record
description: Walks the global table from index seven downward, copying each pair into the record's two position bytes and calling a helper per step. It finally sets a secondary byte to 4.

name: read_digit_key_and_offset
description: Loops until a byte in a ten-value range arrives, calls three helpers, and returns that byte plus 80.

name: read_bounded_digit_into_record
description: Sets a flag, waits for a byte between 176 and 180, clears the flag and stores the value plus 80 in the record before calling helpers.

name: accumulate_bcd_sum_of_count
description: Stores the input byte in the record. When the count is zero it clears a counter byte and returns; otherwise it adds the byte repeatedly into a BCD running sum.

name: store_value_below_limit
description: Reads a byte and, when it is under 153 and the flag is clear, stores it at secondary record offset 30. Otherwise it calls a helper and returns.

name: store_value_at_secondary_35
description: Reads a value and stores it into the secondary record at offset 35 when the flag is clear.

name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns; it is only a forwarding stub.

name: store_value_at_secondary_28
description: Reads a value and stores it into the secondary record at offset 28 when the flag is clear.

name: store_value_and_compare_bounds
description: Stores a read value at secondary offset 26 and compares it with the byte at offset 28, returning early when it is smaller and otherwise applying a BCD adjustment.

name: add_bcd_to_indexed_byte
description: Adds an input byte to a secondary-record byte selected by an index, adjusts the sum as BCD and returns the adjusted neighbouring byte.

name: store_word_at_index
description: Writes the low and high bytes of a register into two consecutive secondary-record bytes selected by an index.

name: add_bcd_to_indexed_entry
description: Calls a helper, then adds an input byte in BCD to a secondary-record byte selected by an index.

name: set_indexed_byte_to_max
description: Writes the constant 153 (BCD 99) into a secondary-record byte selected by an index.

name: decrement_bcd_until_zero
description: Decrements a BCD value in the input register, adjusting after each step, until it reaches zero.

name: count_bcd_increments_into_record
description: Stores the input byte in a record byte, then loops that many times adding one in BCD while decrementing the stored byte.

name: subtract_bcd_pair_with_borrow
description: Subtracts an input byte in BCD from a two-byte secondary value with borrow, then applies a further adjustment when the first byte is below the input.

name: scan_until_special_byte_matches
description: Sets a record byte to three and loops calling a helper, decrementing that byte, until a secondary-record byte matches one of two fixed values.

name: poll_helper_forever
description: Calls two helper routines and then loops calling a helper with no exit.

name: copy_state_and_dispatch_mode
description: Saves and clears the mode byte. When it was zero it copies the first two bytes and byte 11 into fields 77, 78 and 74 and calls a helper; when it is 128 it checks byte 21 before continuing.

name: store_mode_from_argument
description: Writes an argument from the stack into the record's mode byte and returns.

name: validate_record_against_limits
description: Stores the input in a record byte. When record byte 11 is 22 and the stored value is neither zero nor 24, it returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero or a further computed value.

name: loop_until_secondary_flag_set
description: Clears a record byte, then loops calling six helpers until a bit in a secondary-record byte is set.

name: test_record_byte_for_zero
description: Returns minus one unless the record byte is zero or 24, and returns zero when it is one of those values.

name: save_timer_bytes_to_backup
description: Copies the record's two timer bytes into two backup bytes in the record.

name: restore_timer_bytes_from_backup
description: Copies two backup bytes in the record back into the record's two timer bytes.

name: set_global_two_and_call
description: Sets a global cell to 2, calls a helper and returns.

name: scan_table_and_set_timers
description: Walks a global table from index three, calling helpers for each non-zero entry, setting a record timer byte to 38 and incrementing a second timer byte.

name: scan_secondary_records_for_timers
description: Walks secondary records at a fixed stride and, for each non-zero byte, calls helpers, sets a record timer byte to 38 and increments a second timer byte.

name: measure_global_string_length
description: Copies the input into a global, then walks a zero-terminated global string, incrementing a record byte per character before returning zero.

name: increment_timer_after_two_calls
description: Calls two helpers and then increments a record timer byte.

name: increment_timer_after_call
description: Calls one helper and then increments a record timer byte.

name: set_timers_from_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a secondary-record string up to a zero byte and sets two record timer bytes from that length, the first to 31 minus half the length.

name: add_bcd_to_secondary_pair
description: Calls a helper, adds an input byte in BCD to a secondary-record byte and adjusts the neighbouring byte.

name: set_bcd_pair_to_99
description: Writes the constant 153 (BCD 99) into two consecutive secondary-record bytes.

name: store_pair_then_loop_state
description: Stores two input registers into record bytes 26 and 27, then loops on a state check and calls five helpers.

name: tick_countdown_reload_four
description: When the mode byte is non-zero it decrements a secondary countdown byte. At zero it reloads that byte with 4 and continues with the update path.

name: poll_key_codes_until_match
description: Loops reading a key byte from the secondary record until it matches one of three fixed codes, calling helpers and checking a fourth code along the way.

name: dispatch_key_code_loop
description: Loops over a secondary-record key byte, branching on several fixed codes and calling eight helpers.

name: compare_counter_with_limit
description: Calls two helpers and returns early when the secondary byte at offset 25 is below the helper's value.

name: increment_secondary_bcd_counter
description: Adds one to a secondary-record byte at offset 25 in BCD.

name: check_key_code_pair
description: Calls a helper, then returns minus one unless the secondary byte at offset 17 equals one of two fixed codes, returning zero otherwise.

name: store_adjusted_helper_result
description: Stores a helper result in a record byte and adjusts it by minus 128 when a secondary key byte matches one fixed code, otherwise applying a different adjustment.

name: subtract_bcd_with_borrow_flag
description: Subtracts an input byte in BCD from a secondary-record byte, using a borrow flag, and adjusts the neighbouring byte before a helper call.

name: clear_pair_and_call_helpers
description: Clears two secondary-record bytes and calls five helper routines.

name: tick_timer_and_update_position
description: Returns early unless the mode byte is zero. It decrements a record timer byte and, at zero, reloads it with 4, then recalculates the position bytes from globals and calls helpers.

name: match_position_then_call_helper
description: Compares two globals with the record's first two bytes and calls a helper only when both match, then returns.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return and no logic; the routine is an empty stub.

name: reset_record_and_copy_state
description: Sets an eleventh record byte to 24, calls three helpers, and when the mode byte is zero copies the record pair into saved fields and clears a secondary byte.

name: delay_loop_on_record_value
description: When a record byte is non-negative it sets a counter to 64 and runs nested decrement loops as a delay before continuing.

name: initialize_record_from_globals
description: When the mode byte is zero it copies the record pair into saved fields and record bytes 2 and 3, clears a secondary byte, sets globals and record byte 11 to fixed values, then calls ten helpers.

name: restore_record_from_saved_state
description: Calls six helpers, restores the record pair from saved fields, clears the mode byte, sets a saved field to 22 and copies it into record byte 11.

name: copy_saved_field_then_call
description: Copies a saved field into record byte 11 and calls two helper routines before returning.

name: load_pair_from_global_index
description: Calls four helpers, loads the record's first two bytes from a global table entry chosen by a global value plus 80, then calls four more helpers.

name: reset_timer_and_scan_table
description: Sets a record timer byte to 24 and scans a global table, computing offsets from each entry before calling helpers.

name: scan_global_table_for_entries
description: When the mode byte is zero, walks a global table backward from index 31, skipping zero entries, and stores a helper result in a secondary byte for each entry.

name: match_table_entries_to_record
description: Walks a global table backward from index 31; for each non-zero entry it compares the record's first two bytes with the stored pair and calls helpers on a match.

name: compute_offsets_from_record_values
description: Sets two position bytes to five minus two record values, checks the results against bounds, and calls helpers.

name: scan_entry_flags_in_table
description: Loops over global table entries, masks their top two bits, and branches on the masked values, calling helpers for each match.

name: check_table_entry_range
description: Returns minus one when the input byte is non-zero and the indexed table entry lies in a fixed range; otherwise it returns zero or a further result.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero with no other logic; the routine is a stub.

name: compute_relative_position_offsets
description: When the mode byte is zero, sets a record byte from the first record byte minus an indexed table entry, calls a helper and stores position offsets derived from the second record byte.

name: store_sum_of_two_helpers
description: Stores one helper result in a record byte, adds a second helper result to that byte and returns.

name: find_table_index_matching_pair
description: Walks a global table backward from index 31 for an entry equal to record bytes 2 and 3, returning the index it finds or failing.

name: search_table_backward_for_match
description: Scans a global table backward from a register index for an entry equal to record byte 2, returning minus one when no entry matches.

name: show_heading_and_level_labels
description: Uses the referenced labels '-WEST', 'HEAD-' and 'LVL:00', sets two record timer bytes to 8 and 24 and calls four helpers.

name: show_compass_direction_labels
description: Refers to the labels '-EAST', 'NORTH' and 'SOUTH', calls two helpers and returns.

name: run_helpers_when_timer_set
description: When a record byte is non-zero it calls three helpers and then returns; otherwise it returns directly.

name: check_flag_chain_and_call
description: Runs a long chain of boolean tests, each calling a helper and branching on its result, across the record's fields.

name: load_table_pair_into_record
description: Stores the input in a record byte, copies table entries into record bytes 4 and 5 across a loop, and calls five helpers.

name: load_table_bytes_into_record
description: Scales the input by eight to index a global table, copies bytes from it and a second table into record bytes 64 and 65, then calls a helper.

name: mask_buffer_bytes_with_helper
description: When record byte 63 equals 32, inverts a helper result and ANDs it into a range of buffer bytes.

name: lookup_global_by_masked_offset
description: Returns a global byte indexed by record byte 64 plus 30, masked to three bits.

name: store_indexed_table_entry
description: Returns early when the record byte exceeds 20; otherwise it reads a table entry scaled by four into record byte 64 and calls a helper. The referenced text is '0Phx'.

name: index_table_and_store
description: Returns when the record byte exceeds 20, sets a global to minus one, indexes a table with five bits shifted by three and stores the entry in a record byte.

name: store_offset_difference_clamped
description: Copies record byte 64 into byte 4, subtracts record byte 124 from it and clamps the result when the subtraction borrows.

name: store_second_offset_difference
description: Copies record byte 126 into byte 5, subtracts record byte 125 from it and clamps the result when the subtraction borrows.

name: compute_step_from_offset_difference
description: When record byte 4 is below byte 5, stores byte 5 and half of it in record bytes 123 and 122, then loops adding a step.

name: compute_half_step_increment
description: Stores byte 5 and half of it in record bytes 123 and 122, then loops adding the step value to byte 122.

name: compute_table_address_from_offsets
description: Derives an index from two record offsets plus fixed constants, scales it and reads a table pointer before copying a byte.

name: dispatch_codes_into_global
description: Sets two record bytes to zero, loops over record positions in steps of four, calls a helper and branches on fixed key codes to set a global cell.

name: map_key_to_mask
description: Maps fixed input codes to mask values stored in a global cell, calling helpers on each branch.

name: select_colour_word_for_code
description: Compares the input byte against fixed key codes and sets a global 32-bit colour word for the matching code, then calls helpers.

name: set_colour_for_remaining_codes
description: Sets a global colour word for each matching fixed key code and calls helpers on the same branch chain.

name: set_colour_for_later_codes
description: Sets the global colour word for the later key codes, using a fallback colour word when the input is non-zero.

name: set_colour_for_last_codes
description: Sets the global colour word for the final key codes and then runs a scanning loop.

name: set_colour_white_and_advance
description: When the input is non-zero it sets a global colour word to all white bits and loops advancing the record position bytes.

name: scan_positions_with_offset_four
description: Sets two record position bytes to their values plus four, then loops calling helpers until a flag is set.

name: set_colour_from_code_loop
description: Loops over input codes, setting a global colour word for each fixed code it matches and calling helpers.

name: select_colour_by_code_value
description: Sets a global colour word from the input value through a chain of fixed code checks, calling helpers on each branch.

name: set_colour_and_advance_position
description: Sets a global colour word with only the third byte set and loops advancing the record position bytes, wrapping at 64 and carrying from the first into the second.

name: set_green_and_advance_position
description: Sets a global colour word with only the second byte set and loops advancing the record position bytes with the same wrap-and-carry step.

name: set_colour_word_and_advance
description: Sets a global colour word to a fixed 32-bit pattern and loops advancing the record position bytes with wrap-and-carry.

name: set_colour_word_then_loop
description: Sets a global colour word to a fixed 32-bit value and runs nested loops that advance the record position bytes.

name: set_colour_ones_and_loop
description: Sets a global colour word to all ones, calls two helpers and then loops advancing the record position bytes.

name: set_colour_word_and_loop
description: Sets a global colour word to a fixed 32-bit value and runs nested loops that advance the record position bytes.

name: call_four_helpers_then_return
description: Calls four helper routines in sequence and returns, with no direct field writes of its own.

name: set_low_colour_and_loop
description: Sets a global colour word to 255 and runs nested loops that advance the record position bytes after calling helpers.

name: set_colour_word_pattern
description: Sets a global colour word to a fixed 32-bit pattern and runs nested loops that advance the record position bytes.

name: advance_position_loop
description: Runs nested loops that advance the record position bytes, wrapping at 64, and call helpers at each step.

name: advance_row_and_swap_global
description: Increments a record byte and resets it when it passes 63, calls helpers, then swaps a global word with a saved copy.

name: find_first_negative_byte
description: Scans global bytes backward from a fixed start and returns the first negative byte found, or zero when none is negative.

name: store_pair_and_derive_index
description: Stores two input bytes in record bytes 110 and 111, derives a third byte from the first plus twice record byte 2, and calls a helper.

name: delay_then_set_globals
description: Runs a short countdown delay, writes two fixed values into a global pair, then calls helpers and branches on their results.

name: stub_no_observable_effect
description: The decompiled body is only a return; the listed instructions show no effect on memory, so the routine is treated as a stub.

name: walk_fixed_stride_records
description: Walks global 24-byte records until a zero flag byte is found, calling a helper on each record and returning the parameter.

name: forward_call_unless_table_end
description: Returns zero when a frame value equals the table end marker; otherwise it forwards the frame arguments to a helper.

name: forward_three_arguments
description: Forwards three frame arguments to a helper and returns.

name: invoke_helpers_with_string_arg
description: When a parameter byte is non-zero it calls a helper, stores a string pointer from the parameters, calls a second helper and returns the pointer.

name: scan_string_until_terminator
description: Sets a frame word to a fixed large constant, increments a counter and reads characters through a pointer in a loop, then calls a small routine that returns zero.

name: open_file_handle_with_flags
description: Calls a helper with a combined flag word and a fixed permission value, stores the returned handle, and returns null when it is minus one.

name: seek_handle_and_store_mode
description: Calls a helper with a handle and fixed arguments, then selects one of two mode values from a flag and stores it in a frame slot.

name: set_mode_test_table_byte
description: Sets a frame slot to 2, calls a helper, and stores zero or a table byte depending on a byte in a global table.

name: call_with_mode_flag_bits
description: Selects 0 or 2 by a flag, combines the value with a frame word and calls a helper with the handle.

name: read_handle_status_or_null
description: Calls a helper with a handle and frame word, stores the result and returns null when the result is minus one.

name: set_mode_one_test_table
description: Selects 1 or 128 by a flag, stores the value in a frame slot and calls a helper.

name: set_mode_one_test_table
description: Sets a frame slot to 1, calls a helper and branches on a byte in a global table, storing zero or a table byte.

name: call_with_mode_and_mask
description: Selects 1 or 2 by a flag, combines the value with a frame word and a fixed mask, then calls a helper.

name: open_file_with_frame_flags
description: Calls a helper with a frame word combined with a fixed flag and permission value, stores the returned handle, and returns null when it is minus one.

name: set_mode_two_test_table
description: Selects 2 or 128 by a flag, stores the value in a frame slot and calls a helper.

name: set_mode_two_test_table
description: Sets a frame slot to 2, calls a helper and branches on a byte in a global table, storing zero or a table byte.

name: test_table_byte_and_store
description: Calls a helper, then branches on a byte in a global table and stores either zero or a byte from the frame.

name: clear_handle_slot_and_status
description: Clears a slot pointer's stored field and copies the low byte of a frame value into an adjacent byte.

name: process_object_flag_bits
description: Checks flag bits in a structure, calls helpers for the set bits and checks a further pointer field before calling more helpers.

name: check_index_table_flag
description: When a global flag is set, checks that an index is within a global limit and that its table byte has the top bit set, then calls helpers and returns a value.

name: find_matching_slot_index
description: Loops over global slots up to a limit and returns the index of the slot matching the parameter, stopping at an empty entry.

name: check_slot_limit_toggle_bit
description: At the slot limit it sets a global to 24 and returns minus one; otherwise it calls a helper and toggles the top bit of a frame word.

name: toggle_flag_and_store_pointer
description: Calls a helper, toggles bit 15 of a frame word and stores the resulting pointer in a frame slot.

name: set_status_byte_from_mode
description: Sets a status byte to 128, then branches on the low bits of a frame word and writes a status value based on a mode flag.

name: set_status_bit_from_flag
description: Sets a status byte from a flag, combining bit 5 with a value of 8 or 0 chosen by a flag bit, then checks further flags.

name: set_status_bit_delete_file
description: Sets status bit 5 and deletes the named file when a flag bit is set, then continues with a status check.

name: set_status_bits_from_flag
description: Sets status bits from a flag, combining bits 5 and 6 with a value of 8 or 0 chosen by a flag bit.

name: set_status_bits_delete_file
description: Sets status bits 5 and 6 and deletes the named file when a flag bit is set.

name: clear_status_and_return_error
description: Clears a status byte, sets a global to 22 and returns minus one.

name: delete_file_and_open_handle
description: Deletes the named file when a flag bit is set, then checks a mode field and opens a file handle.

name: open_file_with_fixed_mode
description: Calls the file open function with a fixed mode code, stores the returned handle and records the result in a structure field.

name: return_stored_result
description: Returns a result value stored in a frame slot; the routine has no other logic.

name: call_with_masked_flags
description: Clears a status bit in the second argument, combines the arguments with a fixed flag word and forwards them to a helper.

name: read_file_into_buffer
description: When the count is non-negative, looks up a file handle through a helper and reads the requested bytes into the buffer.

name: read_file_using_frame_args
description: Reads bytes from a file handle taken from a structure into the buffer named in the frame, stores the byte count and checks for an error code.

name: write_file_from_buffer
description: When the count is non-negative, gets a file handle from a helper, checks a flag bit and writes the buffer bytes to the file.

name: seek_file_position
description: Gets a file handle from a helper and, when the seek mode is below three, seeks to the requested position in the file.

name: close_file_handle_if_open
description: Finds a pointer through a helper, returns minus one when it is null, returns zero when a flag bit is set and otherwise closes the file handle.

name: delete_file_record_error
description: Deletes the named file, and when deletion fails it stores the error code, sets a global to 2 and returns minus one.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero with no other logic.

name: open_global_file_handle
description: Opens a global file name with a fixed mode and stores the returned handle in a global.

name: read_cached_byte_from_file
description: When a global flag is set and a file handle exists, reads one byte from the file, returning a cached byte and clearing it when present.

name: read_single_byte_from_file
description: Reads one byte from the global file handle into a frame cell and returns that byte.

name: write_single_byte_to_file
description: When a global flag is clear and a handle exists, writes one byte to the file and returns it.

name: store_byte_if_slot_empty
description: Stores the low byte of its argument in a global when that slot is empty, otherwise returns minus one.

name: store_argument_byte_global
description: Stores the low byte of a frame argument into a global cell and returns.

name: close_open_table_handles
description: Loops over a table of six-byte entries up to a global count and closes each handle whose flag bit is clear.

name: open_intuition_library_request
description: Opens the referenced intuition.library, calls an auto-request function with fixed dimensions, then calls a helper with 20 and returns.

name: show_player_label_and_loop
description: Uses the referenced label '----PLAYER-', loops over a per-player index, sets record fields and calls nine helpers.

name: tick_counter_and_copy_entry
description: Decrements a counter in the record and, at zero, reloads it with 160 and copies a global table entry into a secondary byte.

name: dispatch_input_codes_to_handlers
description: Copies a table entry into a secondary byte, branches on a record state and several fixed input codes, calls eleven helpers and sets two timer bytes to 24.

name: compute_position_from_table_sum
description: Adds record offsets to table entries to derive a position, checks it against a range of eleven values and calls four helpers.

name: dispatch_input_switch_codes
description: Switches over input codes with fixed values, setting a record field to 120 for one code and calling helpers for each branch.

name: read_code_until_handled
description: Sets a record field to 122, calls helpers, then loops reading a code and handling it when it matches a fixed value.

name: compute_position_from_table_offsets
description: Derives two position bytes from record offsets plus table lookups and calls seven helpers.

name: store_input_and_check_secondary
description: Stores the input byte in a record field and, when it is zero, compares a secondary byte with a fixed value before calling helpers.

name: check_flag_threshold_then_call
description: Returns early when a flag bit is set and a record byte exceeds 45; otherwise it calls helpers and returns.
